description: REPARTO CORSE TECHNOLOGIES Designed to give its all on the racetracks, AQUILA ROSSA is produced with Monolith technology, thanks to which the 930 gram carbon frame takes structure and shape entirely from a single mold in the total absence of juncture points, creating a true monocoque. The homogeneity of the distribution of the carbon fibres benefits the weight, rigidity and distribution of vibrations throughout the structure, bringing performance to the highest levels. This allows you to smooth out the roughness of the trail and make the bike ultra-fast. IDEAL FOR Designed for the world of competition this hard tail is perfect for cross country and XCM. Ideal for medium-long distances, it allows you to better tackle mountain paths and routes with challenging gradients. PERFECT FOR YOU IF If you are a marathon cross-country rider or simply if you are looking for a light and agile mountain bike that makes no compromises.
